label: Bible Study
prompt: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be _____: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
verse: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
note: Isaiah's short song of thanksgiving — it echoes the very words Moses sang after the Red Sea crossing.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: _____ art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.
verse: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.
note: Moses's final blessing ends with a cheer: Happy art thou, O Israel — a people saved by the LORD.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But when he saw the wind _____, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
verse: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
note: Peter was doing fine on the water until he noticed the wind was boisterous — then the sinking started.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Thou shalt rise up before the _____ head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.
verse: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.
note: 'Hoary' means white-haired — the Law told Israel to stand up when the elderly entered the room.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: There _____ therefore a rest to the people of God.
verse: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
note: 'There remaineth therefore a rest' — a Sabbath-rest for God's people that the land of Canaan only previewed.
